description.value: Prado Cafe is a Vancouver specialty coffee institution founded by Sammy Piccolo, a four-time Canadian Barista Champion who has represented Canada at the World Barista Championships. The Fraser Street location is one of eight cafes across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Surrey, each built around craft espresso and a genuine neighbourhood-first ethos. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Street corridor will find a well-regarded independent-style coffee destination with in-store pickup available.

concerns: OSM name is 'Prado Cafe' but the brand has publicly rebranded to 'Prado Coffee' per the about page ('As we've grown, Prado Cafe has evolved to Prado Coffee'); legal entity on the contact page remains 'Prado Cafe Ltd'.
Phone number 604-336-9277 was sourced from the website /policies/contact-information page; OSM record contains no phone field, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
